senses.en: the study of human society and social behavior

ex.en: She is majoring in sociology because she wants to understand inequality.
ex.zh: 她主修社會學，因為她想了解不平等的問題。

senses.en: (poetic) the sun, personified; the Roman sun god

ex.en: In the old poem, Sol drives his golden chariot across the sky.
ex.zh: 在那首古詩裡，太陽神駕著金色戰車橫越天空。

mn: solar（太陽的）就是從 Sol 來的。

senses.en: comfort in a time of sadness
to give comfort to

ex.en: After her father died, she found solace in music.
ex.zh: 父親過世後，她在音樂中找到慰藉。

senses.en: relating to or powered by the sun

ex.en: The school installed solar panels on its roof.
ex.zh: 學校在屋頂裝了太陽能板。

senses.en: a soft metal alloy melted to join metal parts
to join with solder

ex.en: You need to solder the wire to the circuit board.
ex.zh: 你需要把電線焊到電路板上。

parts.m: solid 固體（拉丁文 solidare 使堅固）

root.note: 使接合處堅固 → 焊接

mn: 美式發音 l 不發音，唸 [ˋsɑdɚ]。

senses.en: a person who serves in an army
(soldier on) to keep going despite difficulties

ex.en: The soldier wrote letters home every week.
ex.zh: 那名士兵每週都寫信回家。

senses.en: a grammatical mistake
a breach of good manners

ex.en: The editor corrected every solecism in the student's essay.
ex.zh: 編輯把學生作文裡的每個文法錯誤都改正了。

parts.m: speaking incorrectly 說話不正確（希臘文 soloikos，指 Soloi 城的人說希臘語不標準）

root.note: 像 Soloi 城人一樣說錯話 → 語法錯誤

senses.en: (British) a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares documents
(US) a person who asks for business or donations
(US) the chief law officer of a city or department

ex.en: She asked her solicitor to review the contract before signing.
ex.zh: 她在簽約前請事務律師先審閱合約。

mn: 美國門口常見的 No Solicitors 是「謝絕推銷」。

senses.en: care or concern for someone

ex.en: The nurse treated every patient with great solicitude.
ex.zh: 那位護理師對每位病人都非常關懷。

parts.m: anxious 焦慮的（拉丁文 sollicitus）

root.note: 為人焦慮擔心 → 關懷

senses.en: a speech in a play in which a character speaks their thoughts aloud alone

ex.en: Hamlet's soliloquy "To be or not to be" is world-famous.
ex.zh: 哈姆雷特那段「生存還是毀滅」的獨白舉世聞名。

senses.en: the time of year when the sun is farthest north or south, giving the longest or shortest day

ex.en: The summer solstice is the longest day of the year.
ex.zh: 夏至是一年中白天最長的一天。

root.note: 太陽彷彿停住不動 → 至日

senses.en: able to be dissolved in a liquid
(of a problem) able to be solved

ex.en: Sugar is soluble in water, but sand is not.
ex.zh: 糖可溶於水，沙子則不行。

senses.en: having enough money to pay one's debts
a liquid that can dissolve other substances

ex.en: The business struggled but managed to stay solvent.
ex.zh: 這家公司經營艱難，但仍有能力償債。

senses.en: dark or dull in color
serious, sad, and gloomy

ex.en: The mood at the funeral was somber.
ex.zh: 葬禮上的氣氛很凝重。

root.note: 在陰影之下 → 昏暗、陰沉

senses.en: causing sleep

ex.en: The professor's somniferous lecture put half the class to sleep.
ex.zh: 教授那堂催眠般的課讓半個班都睡著了。

root.note: 帶來睡眠的 → 催眠的

senses.en: sleepiness; drowsiness

ex.en: This medicine may cause somnolence, so do not drive after taking it.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能讓人嗜睡，服用後請勿開車。

senses.en: sleepy; drowsy
causing sleepiness; very quiet

ex.en: We drove through a somnolent village where nothing seemed to move.
ex.zh: 我們開車經過一個寂靜的小村莊，彷彿一切都靜止了。

senses.en: a piece of music for one or two instruments, usually in several movements

ex.en: She played a Beethoven sonata at her piano recital.
ex.zh: 她在鋼琴獨奏會上彈了一首貝多芬的奏鳴曲。

root.note: 用樂器發聲演奏的曲子 → 奏鳴曲

senses.en: a poem of fourteen lines with a fixed rhyme scheme

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote more than 150 poems in the sonnet form.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞寫了超過 150 首十四行詩。

root.note: 小小的歌 → 十四行詩

senses.en: (of a sound) deep, full, and rich
(of speech) impressive in style

ex.en: The actor's sonorous voice filled the whole theater.
ex.zh: 那位演員渾厚的嗓音響徹整個劇院。

root.note: 聲音飽滿的 → 宏亮的

senses.en: a person believed to be able to predict the future

ex.en: The soothsayer warned Caesar to beware the Ides of March.
ex.zh: 預言家警告凱撒要小心三月十五日。

root.note: 說出真相的人 → 預言家

senses.en: a false argument that seems clever, used to deceive

ex.en: His claim that stealing from the rich is fair is a mere sophism.
ex.zh: 他說偷有錢人的東西很公平，這只是一種詭辯。

root.note: 耍聰明的論點 → 詭辯

senses.en: using clever but false arguments

ex.en: The lawyer's sophistical reasoning did not fool the judge.
ex.zh: 律師的詭辯沒有騙過法官。

senses.en: a person with a lot of worldly experience and refined taste
senses.zh: 老於世故的人；品味高雅的人

senses.en: to make less natural or more refined

ex.en: The city sophisticate found country life a little boring.
ex.zh: 那個見多識廣的都市人覺得鄉下生活有點無聊。

senses.en: the use of clever but false arguments to deceive

ex.en: The debate was full of sophistry and empty slogans.
ex.zh: 這場辯論充斥著詭辯和空洞的口號。

root.note: 古希臘「智者（sophist）」的手法 → 詭辯

senses.en: the highest singing voice, or a singer with this voice

ex.en: The soprano hit the high note perfectly.
ex.zh: 女高音完美地唱出那個高音。

parts.m: above 上面（義大利文 sopra，= super）

root.note: 在最上面的聲部 → 女高音

senses.en: the use of magic, especially evil magic

ex.en: In the story, the queen used sorcery to put the princess to sleep.
ex.zh: 故事裡，王后用巫術讓公主沉睡。

parts.m: lot, fate 籤、命運（拉丁文 sors）

root.note: 抽籤占卜命運 → 巫術

senses.en: morally shameful or dishonest
dirty and unpleasant

ex.en: The newspaper revealed the sordid details of the bribery scandal.
ex.zh: 報紙揭露了這起賄賂醜聞的不堪細節。

senses.en: a thing kept as a reminder of a place or event

ex.en: I bought a small souvenir for my sister in Kyoto.
ex.zh: 我在京都幫妹妹買了一個小紀念品。

parts.m: under, up 從下往上（= sub-）

senses.en: thinly scattered; small in number or amount

ex.en: Vegetation is sparse in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡植物稀少。

root.note: 散布開來的 → 稀疏的

senses.en: (spartan) simple and lacking comfort or luxury
relating to ancient Sparta

ex.en: The hostel room was Spartan, with only a bed and a chair.
ex.zh: 青年旅館的房間很簡陋，只有一張床和一把椅子。

root.note: 像斯巴達人一樣刻苦 → 簡樸的

senses.en: occurring in brief, irregular bursts
caused by or like a muscle spasm

ex.en: His efforts to study were spasmodic, so his grades stayed low.
ex.zh: 他讀書總是斷斷續續，所以成績一直很差。

root.note: 像痙攣一樣一陣一陣的 → 間歇的

senses.en: to concentrate on a particular subject or skill

ex.en: She decided to specialize in heart surgery.
ex.zh: 她決定專攻心臟外科。

root.note: 專注於某一種類 → 專攻

senses.en: a field in which someone is an expert
a product or dish that a place is famous for

ex.en: Beef noodle soup is the restaurant's specialty.
ex.zh: 牛肉麵是這家餐廳的招牌菜。

root.note: 特別的一種 → 專長、特產

senses.en: money in the form of coins rather than notes

ex.en: During the crisis, banks stopped paying out specie.
ex.zh: 危機期間，銀行停止兌付硬幣。

parts.m: kind, form 形式（拉丁文 in specie，以實物形式）

root.note: 以實物形式支付 → 硬幣

mn: 別和 species（物種）搞混；specie 是硬幣。

senses.en: a group of living things that can breed together

ex.en: This species of frog is found only in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這種青蛙只有在台灣才找得到。

root.note: 外觀相同的一類 → 物種

mn: 單複數同形：one species, two species。

senses.en: an example of something used for study or testing

ex.en: The museum has a rare specimen of an ancient fish.
ex.zh: 博物館有一件罕見的古代魚類標本。

root.note: 拿來看的東西 → 樣本

senses.en: seeming reasonable or true but actually false
senses.zh: 似是而非的；華而不實的

ex.en: His argument sounded good, but it was based on specious reasoning.
ex.zh: 他的論點聽起來不錯，但推理似是而非。

root.note: 只是看起來好看 → 似是而非

senses.en: a person who watches an event, especially a sports event

ex.en: Every spectator in the stadium stood up and cheered.
ex.zh: 體育場裡的每位觀眾都站起來歡呼。

senses.en: a ghost
something frightening that may happen

ex.en: The specter of war hung over the region.
ex.zh: 戰爭的陰影籠罩著這個地區。

senses.en: the band of colors produced when light is split
a wide range of related ideas or qualities

ex.en: People from across the political spectrum supported the bill.
ex.zh: 政治光譜上各派的人都支持這項法案。

root.note: 看得見的景象 → 光譜

senses.en: to form a theory without firm evidence
to invest in something risky hoping for profit

ex.en: Scientists can only speculate about what caused the explosion.
ex.zh: 科學家只能推測爆炸的原因。

senses.en: a person who invests in risky things hoping for quick profit

ex.en: A land speculator bought the farm and sold it a year later for twice the price.
ex.zh: 一個炒地皮的人買下那座農場，一年後以兩倍價格賣出。

root.note: 觀望行情的人 → 投機者

senses.en: the quality of being shaped like a sphere

ex.en: Satellite data confirmed the near sphericity of the planet.
ex.zh: 衛星資料證實這顆行星近乎球形。

senses.en: a shape that is nearly but not perfectly a sphere

ex.en: Earth is not a perfect ball but a slightly flattened spheroid.
ex.zh: 地球不是完美的球，而是一個稍微扁平的橢球體。

senses.en: an instrument for measuring the curvature of a surface

ex.en: The lab technician used a spherometer to check the curve of the lens.
ex.zh: 實驗室技術員用球徑計檢查鏡片的曲率。

senses.en: having spines or thorns; spiny

ex.en: The spinous leaves of the plant protect it from animals.
ex.zh: 這種植物多刺的葉子能保護它不被動物吃掉。

senses.en: (dated, often offensive) an unmarried woman past the usual age for marriage

ex.en: In the old novel, the spinster aunt lived alone with her cats.
ex.zh: 在那本舊小說裡，未婚的阿姨和她的貓獨自住在一起。

root.note: 紡紗的女人（多為未婚女性）→ 未婚女性

mn: 這是帶貶義的舊式用詞，現代英文通常直接說 single woman。

senses.en: done without planning, from a sudden impulse
happening naturally without an outside cause

ex.en: The crowd burst into spontaneous applause.
ex.zh: 群眾自發地爆出掌聲。

parts.m: of one's own accord 自願（拉丁文 sponte）

root.note: 出於自願的 → 自發的

senses.en: lively and full of energy, especially of an older person

ex.en: My sprightly grandmother still hikes every weekend at eighty.
ex.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，精神還很好，每週末都去爬山。

root.note: 像精靈一樣輕快 → 活潑的

senses.en: false or fake; not genuine
based on false reasoning

ex.en: The article made spurious claims about the vaccine.
ex.zh: 那篇文章對疫苗提出了不實的說法。

parts.m: illegitimate 私生的（拉丁文 spurius）

senses.en: to argue noisily about something unimportant
a noisy argument over a small matter

ex.en: The kids always squabble over who gets the front seat.
ex.zh: 孩子們總是為了誰坐前座而吵架。

senses.en: extremely dirty and unpleasant, especially from poverty
morally shameful

ex.en: The refugees lived in squalid conditions without clean water.
ex.zh: 難民住在沒有乾淨水源的骯髒環境中。

parts.m: be dirty 骯髒（拉丁文 squalere）

senses.en: a person who lives in a building or on land without permission
senses.zh: 擅自占用房屋或土地的人

ex.en: A squatter had moved into the abandoned house.
ex.zh: 有人擅自住進那間廢棄的房子。

senses.en: (of water or air) not flowing and often smelly
showing no activity or growth

ex.en: Wages have remained stagnant for over a decade.
ex.zh: 薪資已經停滯了十多年。

root.note: 像池塘裡的死水 → 停滯的

senses.en: to stop developing or growing
(of water) to stop flowing and become stale

ex.en: Without new ideas, the company will stagnate.
ex.zh: 沒有新點子，這家公司會停滯不前。

senses.en: the state of not flowing, moving, or developing

ex.en: The country suffered years of economic stagnation.
ex.zh: 這個國家經歷了多年的經濟停滯。

senses.en: exaggerated and unnatural, as if on stage

ex.en: The actor's stagy performance made the movie feel fake.
ex.zh: 那位演員誇張做作的表演讓這部電影顯得很假。

root.note: 像在舞台上一樣 → 做作的

senses.en: serious, dull, and old-fashioned

ex.en: The staid old bank tried to attract young customers with a new app.
ex.zh: 那家古板的老銀行推出新 App，想吸引年輕客戶。

parts.m: stayed 留住（stay 的舊過去分詞）

root.note: 一直停在原地不動 → 古板、沉穩

senses.en: an adult male horse that has not been castrated

ex.en: The black stallion galloped across the field.
ex.zh: 那匹黑色公馬在田野上奔馳。

senses.en: an upright bar or post that supports something

ex.en: She held on to a metal stanchion as the bus turned.
ex.zh: 公車轉彎時，她抓住一根金屬立柱。

senses.en: a group of lines forming a unit in a poem

ex.en: Read the first stanza of the poem aloud.
ex.zh: 把這首詩的第一節大聲唸出來。

parts.m: room, stopping place 房間、停留處（義大利文）

root.note: 詩中停頓的一個「房間」→ 詩節

senses.en: the skill of managing government and state affairs

ex.en: Ending the war required great statecraft and patience.
ex.zh: 結束這場戰爭需要高明的治國手腕和耐心。

senses.en: not moving or changing
crackling noise on a radio or TV
static electricity

ex.en: Prices have remained static for the past three months.
ex.zh: 過去三個月價格都維持不變。

root.note: 站著不動的 → 靜止的

senses.en: the branch of mechanics dealing with bodies at rest and balanced forces

ex.en: Engineers study statics to make sure bridges stay standing.
ex.zh: 工程師學習靜力學，確保橋樑穩穩站立。

senses.en: not moving

ex.en: The car hit a stationary truck parked on the shoulder.
ex.zh: 那輛車撞上一台停在路肩的卡車。

root.note: 站在原處的 → 靜止的

mn: stationAry（靜止的，A 想成 at rest）；stationEry（文具，E 想成 envelope）。

senses.en: an expert in statistics

ex.en: The statistician warned that the sample size was too small.
ex.zh: 統計學家警告樣本數太少。

senses.en: (of a woman) tall, graceful, and dignified
senses.zh: （女性）高挑優雅的；如雕像般的

ex.en: The statuesque model walked confidently down the runway.
ex.zh: 那位身材高挑的模特兒自信地走上伸展台。

root.note: 像雕像一樣 → 高挑優雅

senses.en: a small statue

ex.en: The Oscar is a gold-plated statuette.
ex.zh: 奧斯卡獎是一座鍍金的小雕像。

senses.en: a person's natural height
importance or reputation gained by ability

ex.en: She is a scientist of international stature.
ex.zh: 她是一位享譽國際的科學家。

root.note: 站起來的高度 → 身高、地位

senses.en: a written law passed by a legislature

ex.en: The new statute makes it illegal to text while driving.
ex.zh: 新法規定開車時傳簡訊是違法的。

mn: statute of limitations 是「追訴時效」。

senses.en: cautious and secret action or movement
(of aircraft) designed to avoid radar

ex.en: The cat crept toward the bird with great stealth.
ex.zh: 那隻貓悄悄地朝小鳥靠近。

root.note: 像小偷一樣 → 偷偷摸摸

senses.en: relating to stars
outstanding; excellent

ex.en: She gave a stellar performance in the final match.
ex.zh: 她在決賽中表現得非常出色。

root.note: 星星的 → 像明星一樣出色

senses.en: a large area of flat, grassy land without trees, especially in Eastern Europe or Asia

ex.en: Nomads have herded horses across the Mongolian steppe for centuries.
ex.zh: 幾百年來，遊牧民族一直在蒙古大草原上放牧馬群。

mn: 發音同 step；北美的叫 prairie，南美的叫 pampas。

senses.en: British money
(of silver) of standard high purity
excellent; of great value

ex.en: He has a sterling reputation for honesty.
ex.zh: 他以誠實享有極好的名聲。

mn: sterling silver 是純度 92.5% 的「925 純銀」。

senses.en: to prevent something from developing or being expressed
to make it hard to breathe

ex.en: Too many rules can stifle creativity.
ex.zh: 太多規定會扼殺創意。

senses.en: a mark of shame associated with something
the part of a flower that receives pollen

ex.en: There is still a stigma attached to mental illness.
ex.zh: 心理疾病至今仍背負著污名。

parts.m: prick, mark 刺、烙印（希臘文 stizein）

root.note: 烙在身上的印記 → 恥辱

senses.en: a short dagger with a narrow blade
a woman's shoe with a very thin high heel

ex.en: She could barely walk on the cobblestones in her stiletto heels.
ex.zh: 她穿著細高跟鞋，在石板路上幾乎走不動。

parts.m: dagger 匕首（義大利文 stilo）

root.note: 小匕首 → 像匕首一樣細的高跟

senses.en: a substance that increases activity in the body or mind

ex.en: Caffeine is a mild stimulant found in coffee and tea.
ex.zh: 咖啡因是咖啡和茶中含有的溫和興奮劑。

root.note: 像刺棒一樣刺激的東西

senses.en: to encourage activity or growth
to make someone interested or excited

ex.en: The government cut taxes to stimulate the economy.
ex.zh: 政府減稅以刺激經濟。

senses.en: something that causes a reaction
something that encourages activity or growth

ex.en: The pupil of the eye shrinks in response to a light stimulus.
ex.zh: 瞳孔會因光線刺激而縮小。

senses.en: unwilling to give or spend money

ex.en: He is so stingy that he never tips at restaurants.
ex.zh: 他小氣到在餐廳從不給小費。

mn: 發音是 [ˋstɪndʒɪ]，g 唸 [dʒ]，和 sting（刺）不同音。

senses.en: a fixed regular payment, such as for a student or intern

ex.en: Graduate students receive a monthly stipend for teaching.
ex.zh: 研究生教課每個月可領一筆津貼。

parts.m: coin, wages 錢幣（拉丁文 stips）

senses.en: an ancient Greek philosophy teaching self-control and acceptance of fate
(stoicism) endurance of pain or hardship without complaint

ex.en: She faced her illness with remarkable stoicism.
ex.zh: 她以驚人的堅忍面對病痛。

parts.m: porch 柱廊（希臘文，創始人在此講學）

root.note: 柱廊學派 → 堅忍的哲學

senses.en: calm and showing little emotion

ex.en: The stolid guard didn't react even when tourists made faces at him.
ex.zh: 遊客對著他做鬼臉，那個不動聲色的衛兵也毫無反應。

parts.m: dull, stupid 遲鈍（拉丁文 stolidus）

senses.en: a narrow passage of water connecting two seas
(straits) a difficult situation

ex.en: Ships pass through the Taiwan Strait every day.
ex.zh: 每天都有船隻通過台灣海峽。

parts.m: narrow, tight 狹窄（拉丁文 strictus）

mn: in dire straits 是「陷入困境」；和 straight（直的）同音。

senses.en: a plan or trick to deceive an enemy or achieve a goal

ex.en: The general used a clever stratagem to trap the enemy.
ex.zh: 將軍用了一條妙計困住敵軍。

senses.en: a layer of rock or soil
a level or class of society

ex.en: Fossils were found in a deep stratum of limestone.
ex.zh: 化石是在一層很深的石灰岩層中發現的。

senses.en: a small stream

ex.en: A clear streamlet ran beside the hiking trail.
ex.zh: 一條清澈的小溪沿著登山步道流過。

senses.en: strictness; the quality of being severe
a shortage of money or credit

ex.en: The stringency of the safety rules surprised the new workers.
ex.zh: 安全規定之嚴格讓新進員工很驚訝。

senses.en: strict, precise, and demanding

ex.en: The factory must follow stringent environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 這家工廠必須遵守嚴格的環保法規。

parts.m: draw tight 拉緊（拉丁文 stringere）

root.note: 拉得很緊的 → 嚴格的（strict 同源）

senses.en: a young man; a youth

ex.en: He was just a stripling when he joined the navy.
ex.zh: 他加入海軍時還只是個毛頭小子。

senses.en: spending a lot of time studying
done deliberately and carefully

ex.en: She is a studious girl who spends most evenings in the library.
ex.zh: 她是個用功的女孩，大部分晚上都待在圖書館。

senses.en: to make someone feel bored or dull by routine
to make something ineffective or useless

ex.en: Endless paperwork can stultify even the most creative employee.
ex.zh: 沒完沒了的文書工作連最有創意的員工都會被磨得呆滯。

senses.en: extremely impressive or large

ex.en: The view from the mountaintop was stupendous.
ex.zh: 山頂的景色令人嘆為觀止。

senses.en: a state of near unconsciousness or confusion

ex.en: He wandered around in a stupor after working all night.
ex.zh: 熬夜工作後，他恍恍惚惚地到處晃。

senses.en: persuasion, as opposed to force

ex.en: The teacher relied on moral suasion rather than punishment.
ex.zh: 這位老師靠道德勸說，而不是懲罰。

senses.en: charming, confident, and elegant, especially of a man

ex.en: The suave spy talked his way past the guards.
ex.zh: 那個圓滑的間諜靠一張嘴就混過了警衛。

parts.m: sweet, pleasant 甜美（拉丁文 suavis）

root.note: 讓人愉快的 → 溫文儒雅

senses.en: slightly acid or sour
(of remarks) somewhat sharp

ex.en: The apple had a pleasant subacid flavor.
ex.zh: 這顆蘋果有種宜人的微酸味。

senses.en: existing or happening underwater

ex.en: The divers explored a colorful subaquatic cave.
ex.zh: 潛水員探索了一個色彩繽紛的水下洞穴。
